facts.fact: SYCOTAX, a card-terminal (TPE) tax collection system, lets the Commune of Ouagadougou census market traders by phone number and track who has paid what, with a paper receipt and an electronic message per payment, per its communal tax-base director (19 November 2025).
The SYCOTAX pilot covers the Gounghin and Koukin Yaar markets in Ouagadougou, with extension to 23 more markets planned, per the commune's finance commission chair (19 November 2025).
